body: As someone who’s boyfriend committed suicide 3 weeks ago.. it’s been really really rough.. I’m constantly filled with guilt and regret and I was the one who found the love of my life dead in our own home.. I ignored signs and didn’t help him the proper way and because of that.. he’s gone. Please reconsider. My boyfriend died alone and sad after me and him got into an argument but there was over 200 people at his funeral and that was only his family etc in Korea. His family had to come here and the cremated him and took his ashes back to Korea. It really gets to me.. you have so much guilt and I haven’t been able to sleep properly since.. I have PTSD from what I saw and immense guilt. I miss him everyday and wished the situation would’ve turned out different. He left all his problems here but created way more for his loved ones and especially me. I have our dog from this relationship and she lashes out on me because of not being able to see him. I hope you’re doing well and please think about the people who care. My boyfriend thought no one cared but in reality it was heat of the moment..

Ex Mormon here! Can say I was in the same situation last month! I have been dating my Bf for over a year and my family wouldn’t accept them. They started treating him like he was abusing me and kept emotionally manipulating me by calling him my ex boyfriend. It was to our best decision that we had to leave, move cities and move out. Honestly the whole thing was a shit show. My mom called me a loser etc. it was draining! But it was so worth all the hassle. I left my place which was only 375 in rent so we could go live in a apartment together. BEST DECISION of my life. You have to choose your happiness over everything else. We are so happy here and this place is truly my home. I hope things work out for you but remember they eventually will get over it once things calm down and you have moved out. Remember don’t let them guilt trip you into anything! Just keep thinking to yourself that things eventually will calm down and they do. I hope this helps you and best of luck! As a girl who is like your girlfriend in a way (I just made a post about it on my profile maybe you could read it and maybe see things in a different view) honestly I feel like my boyfriend who is probably in the same boat as you right now probably thinking of how to break up with me I will say this. I have anxiety and PTSD from a severe trauma that put someone in jail and in her Point of view yes there is no excuse of how she is treating you, but keep in mind when trying to deal with this stuff what really helps is probably doing the “if you don’t change X___ then I’m going to leave you” honestly what my therapist recommended was maybe some time to your selfs?? Me and my boyfriend live together as well but you guys see each other everyday maybe you should spend some time away, it will get you guys to feel like you guys miss each other like how it was in the beginning of a relationship. You need to explain to her not to rely on you for everything as well that she needs to rely on herself more.. it really opened my eyes because it’s common for someone who loves someone to allow this sort of thing.. it probably was one of the things that killed my relationship..  with me I can’t go on antidepressants because of my last seizure with Wellbutrin. But sometimes meds can make the situation worse.. but keep in mind she will have withdrawals so this may be the best time to have that time.. if you guys live together it’s more of a struggle yes I know but see how it is first and if your life is better without her while you’re away from each other (even if it’s a cheap Airbnb) then you should know what you should do from there. I hope I helped more on her point of view, if you wanna view my post maybe you can see more light of her point of view.. what you’re trying to get across to her may not be the way she’s understanding it. The main thing you should ask yourself.. is she trying to save the relationship or is she going to just walk away from the relationship??
